title: Publish memories via shareable public link

requirements.text: Add backend support for publishing a user’s uploaded memories to a shareable public link so that anyone (including unauthenticated visitors) can view the published memories.

quotes: I want to upload memories and make it publish so if i can share link anybody access my memories which i upload

acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores a per-owner publish state that can be enabled/disabled.
Backend generates (and can regenerate) a share identifier/token for the owner that is used in the public link.
Backend provides query methods that allow unauthenticated callers to fetch the published memories by share identifier/token.
Public queries return only published data; if a share link is invalid or publishing is disabled, the backend returns an empty result or a clear error without exposing private memories.
Existing authenticated memory upload/list/get flows continue to work unchanged for the owner.

requirements.text: Update backend access control so private memories remain accessible only to the owner (as today), while published memories are accessible only through the new public-share query APIs and only when the owner has explicitly enabled publishing.

quotes: I want to upload memories and make it publish so if i can share link anybody access my memories which i upload

acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated endpoints (e.g., listUserPhotoMemories/getMemory/listMemories) keep enforcing owner-only access (and admin behavior if applicable).
Unauthenticated callers cannot access any private memories through existing endpoints.
Unauthenticated callers can access published memories only via the new public-share query endpoints and only with a valid share identifier/token.

requirements.text: Add frontend UI for signed-in users to publish/unpublish their memories and copy a shareable link that can be opened by anyone to view the published memories.

quotes: I want to upload memories and make it publish so if i can share link anybody access my memories which i upload

acceptanceCriteria: When the user is authenticated, the UI provides controls to: (1) enable publishing, (2) disable publishing, and (3) copy the current share link to clipboard.
The UI clearly indicates the current publishing status (published/unpublished).
If publishing is enabled, the UI shows the share link in a copyable form (button or input + copy).
If the user is not authenticated, publish controls are not shown and/or an access-required message is displayed.
User-facing text is in English.

requirements.text: Add a public “shared memories” viewing mode in the frontend that detects a share identifier/token in the URL and shows the published memories without requiring Internet Identity sign-in.

quotes: share link anybody access my memories which i upload

acceptanceCriteria: When the app loads with a share identifier/token present in the URL (query or hash), the app renders a public read-only gallery view for the shared memories instead of the private authenticated experience.
The public view uses the backend public-share query API to fetch and display the published memories (image + caption/date where available).
The public view does not show upload, edit, or other authenticated-only controls.
If the share link is invalid or the owner has unpublished, the public view shows a clear empty/error state in English (e.g., “This shared page is unavailable”).

requirements.text: If the backend needs new persistent state to support publishing/share links, add a conditional Motoko migration to preserve existing canister data across upgrade.

quotes: I want to upload memories and make it publish so if i can share link anybody access my memories which i upload

acceptanceCriteria: On upgrade, existing user profiles, memories, and valentine state remain intact.
New publish/share-link state is initialized safely for existing users (defaults to unpublished).
Migration is only introduced/updated if required by a state/schema change (conditional migration policy).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all logic in backend/main.mo).

Do not edit frontend files under immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui (compose instead).
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is allowed).
Allowing the public link to browse or discover all users’ memories without a share identifier/token.
